Ayenda began as a budget hotel chain and since 2023 has focused on software, management, and distribution for independent hoteliers across Latin America. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Chowbus
providers.description: Chowbus is a Chicago-headquartered restaurant technology company founded in 2016 by Linxin Wen and Suyu Zhang. It began as an online food ordering, payment and delivery marketplace for Asian restaurants and has since pivoted to a cloud-based, AI-assisted restaurant operating platform: point of sale, self-ordering kiosks, handheld and tablet ordering, kitchen display systems, waitlist and reservations, online ordering, branded restaurant websites and mobile apps, loyalty, gift cards, SMS marketing, a promotions engine, multi-location management, and an AI suite covering digital ads, social media, creative assets and review insights. Chowbus states it serves 9,000+ restaurants across all 50 U.S. states and Canada with 24/7 bilingual (EN/ZH/ES) support, and raised an $81M growth round in March 2026 led by Prysm Capital and Left Lane Capital. Its POS advertises two-way third-party delivery integration with 45+ marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub and others), and partner-side aggregators such as Deliverect publish Chowbus POS connectors — but as of August 2026 Chowbus publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract, SDK, or sandbox. Its only machine-readable public agent surface is a hand-authored bilingual llms.txt at chowbus.com/llms.txt; a JSON API host (pos-api.chowbus.com) is live and returns a structured error envelope but is undocumented and gated.

providers.name: LAP Coffee
providers.description: LAP Coffee (Life Among People) is a Berlin-founded specialty coffee retail chain operated by Micro Retail Technologies MRT GmbH. It opened its first store in Berlin Mitte in August 2023 and has grown to a network of neighbourhood cafes across Berlin, with further locations and openings in Cologne, Frankfurt, Munich and Hamburg. LAP serves locally roasted specialty coffee at everyday prices from small, high-throughput stores, and runs a consumer mobile app (LAP: Everyday Coffee) for pre-ordering, in-store pickup, a stamps and rewards loyalty program, gifting and referrals, replacing an earlier Apple/Google Wallet stamp pass. LAP is backed by HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass LAP publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or developer documentation; its technology surface is the consumer app, the order.lap.coffee deep-link service and a Webflow marketing site.

providers.name: Superb
providers.description: Superb is a Denmark-based all-in-one Guest Experience Management (GXM) platform for restaurants, cafes and bars, bringing reservations, point of sale, payments, gift cards, online takeaway, guest CRM and marketing together in a single system. Superb does not publish a self-serve, documented public developer API. Guest bookings are taken through a hosted reservation widget, and third-party systems connect through Superb's catalog of pre-built connectors (accounting, payments, staff and stock management, marketing) plus a partner portal at partner.superbexperience.com. Any programmatic reservation, guest, booking or CRM access is partner-gated and arranged directly with Superb. The APIs listed below are logical capability groupings modeled from Superb's public product and help-center material - they are marked endpointsModeled because Superb does not publish endpoint-level REST documentation.

providers.name: Couchsurfing
providers.description: Couchsurfing is a community-driven travel and hospitality-exchange platform that connects travelers with local hosts offering free accommodation, local meetups, and cultural exchange across more than 200,000 cities worldwide. Members build trust through verified profiles, references, and community events, and use the service to find places to stay, meet locals, and discover events while traveling. Couchsurfing publishes no official public developer API or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web, trust, and policy surface for discovery and monitoring, and was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Point Nine.

providers.name: Fairlyne
providers.description: Fairlyne is a French travel-technology company offering a white-label Resale-as-a-Service platform that lets travel brands turn no-shows and low-yield bookings into new revenue by allowing passengers and guests to resell non-refundable tickets and reservations. Founded in 2021 by former Accor executives Gilles de Richemond and Michael d'Eboli, the platform serves airlines, railway and road-transport operators, and hospitality chains, and powers programs such as SNCF Ouigo's resale experience. Fairlyne raised a 3M EUR seed round from Speedinvest, Kima Ventures, Evolem, and FJ Labs. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fairlyne. No public developer API or documentation portal has been identified at this time.

providers.name: HomeAway *
providers.description: HomeAway was an Austin, Texas vacation-rental marketplace that connected travelers with owners and property managers of holiday homes, cabins, condos, and beach houses worldwide. It published a first-party HomeAway API (OAuth 2.0) for listing management, availability and booking synchronization, pricing, and guest communication, along with a Ruby SDK and the hacurl command-line tool from its GitHub organization. HomeAway was acquired by Expedia Group in 2015 and the brand was retired into Vrbo: homeaway.com now redirects to Vrbo and the developer platform is no longer maintained. This profile captures the genuine historical first-party API surface (SDK, CLI, OAuth auth model) that remains publicly available.

providers.name: Inhabitr
providers.description: Inhabitr is a Chicago-founded furnishing company that operates an AI-assisted furniture rental and procurement platform for commercial real estate and residential customers. Its business side (inhabitr.ai) furnishes hospitality, multifamily, student housing, short-term rental, co-living, senior living and office properties end to end — design, sourcing, procurement, delivery, installation and asset tracking — while its consumer storefront (inhabitr.com) rents furniture, sets and decor to households on flexible terms with a browser-based Home Designer tool. The company describes real-time connectivity to warehouses, manufacturers and retailers as the "furniture cloud" behind its bidding and fulfillment, but it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract of any kind as of this profiling pass.

providers.name: Kasa
providers.description: Kasa is a tech-enabled hospitality company operating a curated collection of furnished apartments and boutique hotels across dozens of U.S. cities. Its asset-light model partners with multifamily property owners and hotel operators to run flexible short-term, extended-stay, and corporate accommodations, layering a proprietary technology platform on top for contactless check-in, a virtual front desk, remote guest support, and unit operations. Kasa also serves corporate housing and corporate travel programs. Backed by Ribbit Capital, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a proptech/hospitality provider; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Meragi
providers.description: Meragi is an Indian wedding planning and execution platform for city and destination weddings, offering a plug-and-play alternative to bare-shell venues. It coordinates venue discovery, decor design (10,000+ options), catering, photography, vendor management, and multi-event logistics across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Goa, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, and Udaipur. Backed by Accel, the company runs a consumer-facing web presence with no public developer, API, or integration surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Qwick
providers.description: Qwick is an AI-powered workforce management platform for the hospitality industry, connecting businesses with vetted hospitality professionals ("Pros") for on-demand shifts across 42 states. Its products span the Marketplace (intelligent shift matching), QwickGo (same-day shift posting), Jobs (performance-based hiring with paid working interviews), Compliance (scheduling and time-tracking rules enforcement), and Pay (multi-state W-2 and 1099 payroll). Qwick documents a REST API (v2) plus webhooks for custom integrations exposing shifts, pros, hours, invoices, and compliance data, and pre-built integrations with payroll (ADP, Gusto, Paychex, Paycom), POS (Toast, Square, Lightspeed), HRIS (Workday, BambooHR), scheduling (7shifts, Deputy, When I Work), and SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace). It is headquartered in Charleston, SC and backed by Foundry Group.

providers.name: Raus
providers.description: Raus (operated by StayRaus GmbH, Berlin) is a consumer platform for booking sustainable, design-forward tiny cabins in nature across Germany and Austria, giving city dwellers a quick escape "close to home." Guests browse and book fully-equipped smart cabins in forests, by lakes, and on farms, add culinary experiences and extras, buy gift cards, and can list their own land as a host. Raus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a B2C hospitality/booking brand with a public consumer website but no publicly documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: ResortPass
providers.description: ResortPass is a consumer travel and hospitality marketplace that lets people book hotel and resort day passes — pool access, spa treatments, cabanas, fitness centers, and day rooms — at over 2,000 hotels without an overnight stay, starting around $25. Guests search by city and date, book a pass, and enjoy resort amenities for the day, while partner hotels monetize otherwise-idle amenity capacity. Surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment; the company operates a consumer web/mobile booking product and a hotel partner program.

providers.name: Roomstorm
providers.description: Roomstorm is a real-time B2B hotel room marketplace, best known for building the airline industry's first fully automated platform for providing hotel accommodations to distressed passengers during flight disruptions. Founded by Maksim Izmaylov and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2014), the San Francisco company connects airlines, hotels, and travelers so that irregular-operations (IROPS) rebooking, room sourcing, invoicing, and voucher issuance happen programmatically instead of through manual phone calls. Its backend exposes a JSON REST API (documented in API Blueprint) covering authentication, bookings, hotels, rooms, vacancies, organizations, vouchers, and airport search.

providers.name: Travelio
providers.description: Travelio is one of Indonesia's largest online property rental and management platforms, operated by PT Horizon Internusa Persada. It lists furnished and unfurnished apartments, houses, villas, guest houses, and hotel residences for daily, monthly, and yearly rental across 15+ Indonesian cities including Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Bali, and Yogyakarta, and offers hospitality-grade property management for owners. Backed by 500 Global, Travelio runs consumer web and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, partner integration surface, or developer portal as of this profile.

providers.name: Truly Experiences
providers.description: Truly Experiences is a UK-based experiential gifting company that curates and sells memorable experiences as gifts rather than physical products. Its catalog spans dining, spa treatments, drinks tastings, activities, masterclasses, travel getaways, and premium "dreams come true" experiences, organized by recipient, occasion, price point, and UK location (London, Edinburgh, Birmingham, Manchester and beyond). After checkout customers receive an e-certificate with a unique code, and a concierge team arranges the booking date and time. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass it operates a consumer e-commerce storefront with no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Kovzy Co.
providers.description: Kovzy is a restaurant technology company with offices in Tbilisi, Georgia and Yerevan, Armenia, selling an all-in-one SaaS platform for restaurants and cafes. The product is built from three modules that share one back office - a website builder that gives a restaurant its own online ordering site with no commission on direct sales, a QR digital menu customers browse and order from by scanning a code at the table, and a point-of-sale system that consolidates orders arriving from delivery aggregators (Wolt, Glovo), the QR menu, and the restaurant's own website into a single queue, with kitchen management and recipe and cost tracking on top. Pricing is per module and quoted monthly in Georgian lari, and onboarding is self-service through a hosted signup that provisions a restaurant subdomain. Kovzy was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation as of this profile, so this entry describes the company and its partner surface rather than an API.

providers.name: On the Beach
providers.description: On the Beach Group plc (LSE: OTB) is a Manchester-headquartered online travel agent and the United Kingdom's largest online short-haul beach package holiday specialist, founded in 2004 by Simon Cooper and registered at Aeroworks, 5 Adair Street, Manchester M1 2NQ. It sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain: an asset-light dynamic packager that buys real-time seats from 42 airlines and hotel inventory from bedbanks and direct hotel contracts, combines them into ATOL-protected packages, and sells them direct to UK and Republic of Ireland consumers through onthebeach.co.uk, sunshine.co.uk and its mobile app. FY25 total transaction value was GBP 1.25bn across 1.7 million customers. It is a consumer of other operators' distribution APIs rather than a publisher of its own - it was the first UK OTA to take a direct NDC connection to Emirates' Online B2B API in 2019 and signed a direct Ryanair "Approved OTA" partnership in 2024 - and it explicitly bypasses the GDS layer entirely. Its API posture as a producer is almost non-existent. The FY25 results describe an "API-first microservices architecture" and a proprietary Hotel Discovery Cache managing more than 5 billion hotel prices, but none of that surface is published: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no partner or trade API, and no self-serve access of any kind. Its only remaining B2B channel, Classic Collection, was put into orderly wind-down on 23 September 2025. The single exception, and the first externally addressable machine surface the company has ever shipped, is a ChatGPT App launched on 1 April 2026 - claimed as the first by a UK OTA - which serves live, bookable package combinations to ChatGPT users over MCP. That surface is distribution-gated rather than developer-facing: no endpoint, tool list, schema, auth flow or terms are documented, and a deliberate mcp.onthebeach.co.uk host exists but is Cloudflare WAF-blocked to every probe.

providers.name: Salido
providers.description: SALIDO is a hospitality technology company providing a unified restaurant point-of-sale (POS) and payment processing platform for full-service, casual, upscale, and fine-dining operators. The system combines front-of-house and back-of-house operations, table and floor-plan management, menu and inventory tools, real-time analytics and multi-location reporting, and a mobile manager app, with an in-house payment processor (EPX). Originally a 500 Global / 500 Startups portfolio company, SALIDO was acquired by First Data and is now backed by North American Bancard (NAB). No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Metro Residences
providers.description: MetroResidences is a serviced apartments and furnished-rentals platform offering flexible temporary housing for business travelers, expatriates, and relocating professionals. Its portfolio spans thousands of listings across Singapore, Tokyo, and Australia, ranging from studios to six-plus bedroom units in both furnished and unfurnished configurations, alongside select hotel accommodations. The company also runs a property-management offering that lets owners list and monetize their units. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site exposes no developer program, API, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Mint House
providers.description: Mint House is a US residential-hospitality operator founded in 2017 by Will Lucas that runs tech-enabled apartment-hotel units — full kitchens, workspaces and app-based check-in — in downtown districts of markets including New York, Miami, Nashville, Dallas, Washington DC, Houston, Phoenix and Madison. It raised a $35M Series B in May 2022 led by Mohari Hospitality with Revolution Ventures, Allegion Ventures and Ingleside Investors. In January 2026 Mint House entered an all-equity strategic combination with Kasa; the portfolio now operates as "Mint House by Kasa" and every corporate page on minthouse.com redirects to kasa.com. Mint House is a hospitality operator, not a software vendor: it publishes a consumer booking site and no public API, SDK, webhook or developer program of any kind.

providers.name: P.F. Chang's
providers.description: P.F. Chang's is an American casual-dining restaurant chain specializing in Asian-inspired cuisine, operating restaurants and a Home Menu retail line. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of trinity-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The enrichment pipeline found no public developer API surface: no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery endpoints are published. The only live host, api.pfchangs.com, returns a default Azure Function App page (an internal app backend, not a public API). This profile captures the company's public web and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: PerfectStay
providers.description: PerfectStay is a French online travel company that sells curated flight-plus-hotel packages, all-inclusive stays, guided tours, city breaks and standalone flights, hotels, activities and transfers, marketed around a best-price guarantee (refunding twice any price difference), trip protection and 24/7 customer support, with installment payment options (2x/4x). Founded in Paris and backed by Partech, it also powers private, brand-operated travel-club sale sites. The company exposes no public developer platform, API, SDK or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: SpotHopper
providers.description: SpotHopper is a Milwaukee, Wisconsin based restaurant marketing and web technology company, founded in 2015, selling an all-in-one, AI-assisted platform to independent restaurants and multi-location restaurant groups. The platform bundles restaurant website design and hosting (customer sites are served from the spotapps.co domain), SEO and Google Business Profile syncing, menu / specials / event publishing, automated social posting to Facebook and Instagram, email and SMS campaigns, review generation and reputation management, and link-outs to reservation and ordering partners such as OpenTable, Yelp and UberEats. The company markets itself as powering more than 20,000 restaurants. As of the 2026-08-29 enrichment probe SpotHopper publishes no developer portal, no API reference, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Spectra (Defunct / Merged into OVG360)
providers.description: Spectra (formerly Spectra Experiences, originally Comcast-Spectacor Ventures / Global Spectrum + Ovations Food Services + Paciolan + Front Row Marketing) was a North American venue management, food services & hospitality, and partnership-sales company headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. Owned jointly by Comcast Spectacor and Atairos, Spectra was acquired by Oak View Group (OVG) in a deal announced August 31, 2021 and closed on November 15, 2021 after receiving U.S. Department of Justice approval. On February 25, 2022, OVG formally consolidated Spectra and OVG Facilities into a single, rebranded division called OVG360. The Spectra and Spectra Experiences brands were retired as a result, and the spectraexperiences.com domain is no longer resolvable. This apis.yml is preserved as an historical record only — Spectra never published a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal. Operational successor: OVG360 (https://www.oakviewgroup.com/ovg360-2/). Ticketing platform Paciolan, which had been part of the Spectra portfolio, was divested before the OVG deal and is now an independent Learfield subsidiary.

providers.name: Craftable
providers.description: Craftable is hospitality's back-office software platform for restaurants, bars, hotels, and resorts, originally known for its Bevager and Foodager products, that connects purchasing, inventory, recipes, and accounts payable with accounting and sales data. Its suite spans Intelligent Ordering (eProcurement), AP Automation with Invoice AI, Inventory and Recipe Management, and Daily Actionable Insights, plus AI features such as Operator AI and the Crafty in-app assistant. Craftable is SOC 2 compliant and SSO-capable, with more than 1,000 POS, EDI, and vendor/API integrations spanning systems such as Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Clover, SpotOn, TouchBistro, Aloha by NCR Voyix, Restaurant365, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, QuickBooks, and Xero. Craftable does not publish a public self-service developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through its implementation team during onboarding, and API access to a connected platform is provisioned by requesting a scoped API key from that platform's support team.

providers.name: Apparta
providers.description: Apparta is a Colombian hospitality technology company providing a reservation-management and guest-engagement platform for restaurants, bars, and dining venues across Latin America (Bogota, Medellin, Cali, Barranquilla). The SaaS product covers AI-assisted table assignment and floor-plan zoning, no-show prevention with prepayments and cancellation policies, a WhatsApp AI chatbot for automated bookings, CRM campaigns over SMS/email/WhatsApp, POS integration, branded booking pages and digital menus, and marketing connectors to Google, Google Maps, Instagram, TripAdvisor, and Facebook. Apparta is offered in tiered monthly plans (Basico, Standard, Plus) and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is published as of this profiling; higher tiers expose a WhatsApp Business API integration on behalf of venues rather than a first-party Apparta API.

providers.name: Wynn Resorts
providers.description: Wynn Resorts is a developer, owner, and operator of integrated luxury resorts and casinos, with properties in Las Vegas, Boston Harbor, and Macau. The company does not currently publish a public developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Maestro PMS
providers.description: Maestro PMS is an all-in-one property management software solution serving independent hotels, resorts, and multi-property groups. The platform advertises open APIs that support more than 800 third-party integrations, but does not publish public OpenAPI documentation; integrations are arranged through the partner program.

providers.name: Porte Tech Ltd.
providers.description: Porte Tech Ltd. is a hotel technology company based in Astana, Kazakhstan that offers a digital concierge platform to streamline guest experiences and reduce front-desk workload for hotels. Its product covers digital check-in and check-out, mobile room keys delivered via app, access codes or QR codes, Bluetooth lock upgrades that reuse existing hardware, an in-app guest experience for bookings and amenity ordering, integrations with spa, restaurant and laundry services, and a centralized management dashboard for property staff. Porte is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Local Holdings Limited
providers.description: Local (uselocal.co) is a Gulf Cooperation Council fintech and hospitality-technology company that replaces traditional card terminals with a single QR code guests scan to pay, order, and earn loyalty points instantly. Its pay-at-table, checkout, and remote payment-link flows serve 200+ restaurants, hotels, and hospitals across Bahrain, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, capturing customer profiles from each transaction and feeding real-time revenue, table-turn, and staff-performance analytics back to venues. Local integrates with regional payment methods (BenefitPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, all major cards) and POS platforms including Odoo, Oracle, Lightspeed, Square, and Invo. Local Holdings Limited was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Carnival Corporation
providers.description: Carnival Corporation & plc is the world's largest cruise company operating eight cruise line brands (Carnival Cruise Line, Princess Cruises, Holland America Line, Seabourn, Cunard, P&O Cruises, Costa Cruises, AIDA Cruises), plus the White Pass and Yukon Route. Carnival operates the OceanMedallion wearable IoT technology and mobile experience platform, the Carnival HUB app, the Princess MedallionClass app, and a portfolio of guest-facing digital experiences across its fleet of over 90 ships.

providers.name: H2O Hospitality
providers.description: H2O Hospitality is a South Korea-based hospitality digital-transformation company that connects existing hotel and leisure systems rather than replacing them, streamlining operations from booking to checkout. Its products span three areas: Connect (cloud property-management tooling including Smart CRS, Smart RMS, and Smart FMS), Maximize (revenue and guest-engagement tools such as Smart D2C and AI-based CRM), and Transform (managed operations). It offers smart mobile check-in and automated inventory management, operates across nine countries in Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, and is ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: TouchBistro
providers.description: TouchBistro is an iPad-based restaurant point-of-sale (POS) and management platform covering payments, online ordering, reservations, loyalty, gift cards, marketing, inventory, labor, and reporting. TouchBistro does not publish an open, self-serve developer API or a public developer portal; it exposes a private, partner-only integration API. The CEO has publicly confirmed an API exists but is not openly promoted. Third-party software providers must apply to the integration partner program, be approved, and are issued monitored API keys under negotiated commercial terms (contact integratedpartners@touchbistro.com).

providers.name: Equinox Holdings
providers.description: Equinox Holdings is a privately held luxury lifestyle and fitness company majority-owned by Related Companies. Its portfolio spans high-end fitness clubs (Equinox), boutique indoor cycling (SoulCycle), yoga (Pure Yoga), value-tier gyms (Blink Fitness), luxury hospitality (Equinox Hotels), and a consumer streaming fitness app (Equinox+). The group operates more than 300 club facilities across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom and is positioned around the tagline "It's not fitness. It's life." Equinox Holdings does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a GitHub organization; all consumer experiences are delivered through its native iOS/Android apps and websites, with no documented partner or open API surface.

providers.name: Flexkeeping
providers.description: Flexkeeping is a hotel operations automation platform (owned by Mews) that streamlines housekeeping, maintenance, front-office collaboration, and quality assurance for hotels and resorts. It centralizes staff task management, automated room cleaning schedules, checklists, lost-and-found, and guest service requests, and connects to major property management systems so operational teams can reduce manual work, coordinate across departments, and improve the guest experience across thousands of properties worldwide. Flexkeeping is an integration consumer rather than an API producer: it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or API keys. Instead it ships pre-built connectors into PMS platforms including Mews, Apaleo, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Cloudbeds, RMS Cloud, Guesty, Shiji, Protel, SiHot, and Beds24.

providers.name: Saxbys Coffee
providers.description: Saxbys is a Philadelphia-headquartered hospitality company founded in 2005 by Nick Bayer that operates a small chain of cafes across the U.S. East Coast and Midwest. The brand is unique for its "Experiential Learning Platform" (E.L.P.) — 100% student-run cafes embedded inside college and university campuses. Each E.L.P. cafe is operated by a Student Cafe Executive Officer (SCEO) who takes full responsibility for running the location while earning paid, experiential learning credit. Saxbys describes itself as "a national education company and For Students, By Students" with a mission to "Make Life Better." Saxbys does not publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or partner integration program. The only public digital surfaces are the marketing website (saxbyscoffee.com), location-specific online ordering powered by BentoBox, a "Saxbys Stories" blog, and a mobile ordering / rewards app. The Saxbys GitHub organization exists but currently holds a single internal inventory-analyzer repository. This apis.yml records the company as a non-API hospitality + education brand for the API Evangelist network catalog.

providers.name: Fora
providers.description: Fora is a modern, tech-enabled host travel agency headquartered in New York City, founded in 2021 by Henley Vazquez, Evan Frank and Jake Peters. It equips independent travel advisors with a custom booking portal, 700+ training videos, live support, preferred supplier partnerships, an IATA number, E&O insurance and automated commission collection, powered by a Travelport-backed booking platform and integrations such as Tablet Hotels. Fora runs a consumer traveler app plus an advisor portal and is building agentic AI tooling (Via / Sidekick) to streamline advisor workflows. Backed by Forerunner Ventures and Insight Partners, Fora does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web properties within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Smartness
providers.description: Smartness (formerly Smartpricing) is an Italian hospitality-technology company that helps hotels, B&Bs, and vacation-rental operators automate online operations and grow direct revenue. Its product suite spans AI dynamic pricing (Smartpricing), a property management system (Smartpms), 24/7 guest messaging (Smartchat), email marketing and segmentation (Smartconnect), a website builder (Smartsite), reputation, ads, and payments (Smartpay), serving 4,000+ accommodation providers across Europe. Smartness connects to 80+ PMS and channel-manager platforms through partner integrations, but publishes no public developer API or portal; integrations are arranged via a partnership request. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: Habyt
providers.description: Habyt is a flexible-living and co-living accommodation provider offering furnished studios, apartments, and private rooms for stays ranging from a single night to several months. Positioned as "a new category of living for people in motion," the company blends hotel-style service and amenities with residential flexibility, targeting mobile professionals, relocators, and long-term travelers. Habyt operates properties across Europe (Berlin, Madrid, Vienna, with Lisbon and Milan announced) and Asia (multiple locations in Singapore), and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital. Habyt is a consumer real-estate and hospitality operator rather than an API-first technology provider; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Meitre
providers.description: Meitre is the leading online reservations, guest, and revenue management platform for the world's top restaurants, with a strong presence across Latin America. It provides a hardware-agnostic, white-label toolkit that lets restaurants manage reservations, availability, waitlists, and guest relationships from a single centralized system. Meitre's algorithms automatically manage table availability by analyzing the setup of each area of a restaurant and demand for each slot, and can require credit-card guarantees to virtually eliminate no-shows. Restaurants pay a fixed monthly fee (no commission), and Meitre exposes a partner integration API at meitre-api.com plus an MCP server for AI-powered natural-language restaurant booking.

providers.name: Oyo Rooms
providers.description: OYO Rooms (Oravel Stays / OYO Hotels & Homes) is a hospitality technology company headquartered in Gurugram, India that operates a global chain of franchised and leased budget hotels, homes, and living spaces. Founded by Ritesh Agarwal in 2013, OYO standardizes and distributes independent hotel inventory through its consumer booking apps and website, and provides property owners with a partner management platform for listings, pricing, and operations. OYO is a consumer travel and accommodation brand; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Hotelogix
providers.description: Hotelogix is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) headquartered in Noida, India, serving more than 12,000 independent hotels, groups, chains, and resorts across 100+ countries since 2008. The platform provides front desk management, reservations, point-of-sale, housekeeping, revenue management, multi-property and group management, a web booking engine, a guest service mobile app, and an integrated channel manager that distributes inventory to OTAs and GDS. Hotelogix exposes a partner Web API (HAPI) at developer.hotelogix.net that uses XML POST over HTTP rather than REST/JSON, enabling channel managers, payment gateways, accounting systems, CRMs, loyalty programs, door locks, ID scanners, and in-room devices to integrate with the PMS. Documentation is split into Web (booking engine), Admin, and Frontdesk surfaces. There is no public OpenAPI specification, no public SDK, and no public GitHub org content; partner access and credentials are granted on request through the Hotelogix support and partnership teams. Revenue model is SaaS subscriptions per hotel/room along with an integration marketplace ecosystem.

providers.name: Stanza Living
providers.description: Stanza Living is one of India's largest managed accommodation and co-living platforms, founded in 2017 by IIM-Ahmedabad alumni Anindya Dutta and Sandeep Dalmia and headquartered in Gurugram. It provides professionally managed, fully furnished, brokerage-free residences — student housing, co-living for working professionals, and managed apartments — across 24+ Indian cities, operating 450+ residences and more than 70,000 beds under the promise of "your second home in a new city." The company is backed by investors including Accel, Falcon Edge, Sequoia Capital and Matrix Partners. Stanza Living operates as a consumer web and mobile brand for discovering, booking and living in managed accommodation, and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Bbot
providers.description: Bbot is an order-and-pay solution for the hospitality industry, letting guests scan a QR code to view menus, order, and pay from their phones, including placing orders with a server on the same tab. Bbot was acquired by DoorDash and is now offered as Tableside Order & Pay by DoorDash, serving restaurants, bars, breweries, and hotels with on-premise digital ordering and payment, plus POS integrations such as Toast. Bbot operates owner and admin web portals but does not publish a standalone public or partner-facing developer API or documentation portal, so no API products are listed here.

providers.name: Eventup
providers.description: EventUp is a global online marketplace and directory for event venues, operated by Tripleseat. It lists over 15,000 restaurants, hotels, breweries, rooftop bars, museums, libraries, and other unique spaces that people can browse and request quotes from for parties, weddings, corporate events, and meetings. Event planners and consumers search venues by city, capacity, event type, and amenities and submit free quote requests directly to venue owners, while venue owners list and market their spaces to receive booking inquiries. A companion product, EventUp Planner, adds marketing, planning, and analytics tooling. EventUp is a consumer-facing web marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or agent/MCP surface. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with the discoverability, identity, and domain-security signals that are publicly observable.

providers.name: AltexSoft
providers.description: AltexSoft is a technology and solution consulting company that provides software development and IT consulting services to businesses across various industries. Specializing in travel and hospitality, healthcare, and finance sectors, AltexSoft helps companies design, build, and implement innovative technology solutions to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth.

providers.name: Shelby Williams Industries
providers.description: Shelby Williams Industries is the premier designer, manufacturer, and distributor of seating products in the hospitality and food service industries. With over 70 years of experience, the company produces an extensive line of chairs, barstools, banquet seating, sofas, and tables made from wood, metal, rattan, and fully upholstered materials. Headquartered with US manufacturing in Newport, Tennessee, Shelby Williams serves hotels, restaurants, country clubs, senior living facilities, and banquet venues worldwide. As a contract furniture manufacturer focused on custom B2B orders, Shelby Williams does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: EasyWay Technologies
providers.description: EasyWay Technologies (easyway.ai) builds generative-AI guest-experience agents for the hospitality industry, used by 400+ hotels including Banyan Tree, InterContinental, Fairmont and Sofitel. Its AI Concierge, AI Reservation Manager and AI Receptionist automate guest messaging, bookings and check-in/check-out with 24/7 replies across 100+ languages, integrating with existing hotel systems. A Techstars-backed startup, EasyWay has been acquired by Duve and now operates as part of Duve's guest-experience platform. EasyWay exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record.

providers.name: GuruHotel
providers.description: GuruHotel is AI-native direct-booking infrastructure for independent hotels: an AI-powered hotel website builder, a conversion-optimized direct booking engine, and a Stripe-powered payment-orchestration platform that turns a hotel's official website into a commission-free direct booking channel with real-time inventory, multi-currency checkout and a guest-first experience. Founded in 2019, GuruHotel is trusted by 1000+ hotels, serves 200,000+ guests a year and processes $15M+ in annual gross booking value across the United States, Mexico, the Caribbean and Europe. It connects to hotel PMS platforms directly (Cloudbeds) and through Channex (280+ PMS incl. Mews, apaleo, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Guesty, Hostaway), plus Google for Hotels. GuruHotel is a portfolio company of 500 Global and Anthemis.

providers.name: Las Vegas Sands
providers.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is the world's leading developer and operator of integrated resorts, including The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas (divested in 2022) and Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. The company operates in the casino, hospitality, convention, and entertainment industries.

providers.name: Science On Call
providers.description: Science On Call provides 24/7 AI-powered technology support built specifically for restaurants. Combining intelligent automation with human experts, the service helps restaurant staff triage and resolve operational technology issues across point-of-sale (POS) systems, kitchen display systems (KDS), loyalty programs, staff scheduling, online ordering, training platforms, phones, internet, and Wi-Fi. Staff reach support anytime via text, email, or phone with no app or login required, and issues are typically resolved in about 25 minutes. Science On Call is a Techstars-backed company; billing is handled through a hosted customer portal. This profile currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or machine- readable specification surface.

providers.name: Suiteness
providers.description: Suiteness is a hotel booking platform specializing in connecting rooms and suites that hotels do not make public. Through partnerships with hotels, it surfaces adjoining rooms and suites - marked with a "+" symbol - so families and groups can book twice the space at roughly half the price of booking multiple standard rooms. It combines suite inventory, a concierge collaboration service, and a membership program. Suiteness is a consumer travel booking company backed by Bullpen Capital; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or partner API surface at this time.

providers.name: Caesars Entertainment
providers.description: Caesars Entertainment is the largest U.S. casino-entertainment company, operating over 50 gaming facilities, hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues across the country and internationally. The company operates the Caesars Rewards loyalty program and offers gaming, hospitality, dining, entertainment, meetings and conventions, and retail experiences.

providers.name: Le Collectionist
providers.description: Le Collectionist is a French luxury travel and villa-rental marketplace that curates high-end vacation homes and provides concierge services for guests, alongside a revenue-management offering for property owners and a commission-based referral program for travel agencies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network, the company operates a consumer booking website, an owner portal, and a travel magazine, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic partner integration at this time. Sector: Marketplace / Travel & Hospitality.

providers.name: Avis Budget
providers.description: Avis Budget Group is a leading global provider of vehicle rental and mobility solutions with brands including Avis, Budget, Budget Truck, Payless, and Zipcar.

providers.name: Resti Inc.
providers.description: Resti Inc. (resti.cloud) is a cloud-based restaurant management platform used by restaurant chains, primarily across Kazakhstan and Central Asia. It automates HR and payroll (salary calculation from actual hours worked), operational checklists and standards with photo verification, review and reputation management aggregating 2GIS and Yandex Maps, a mobile learning management system (LMS) for staff onboarding and training, and AI-assisted invoice processing and reconciliation. Resti integrates with restaurant POS and back-office systems including iiko, r_keeper, Paloma 365, Poster, and 1C Retail, and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation; the customer login portal is at my.resti.cloud.

providers.name: Duetto
providers.description: Duetto is a San Francisco–headquartered hospitality technology company providing a cloud-based Revenue and Profit Operating System (RP-OS) for hotels, casinos, resorts, and independent properties. Duetto's platform combines dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, group business optimization, benchmarking, and reporting to help hospitality operators optimize room rates, profitability, and total revenue performance. Core products include GameChanger (real-time dynamic pricing engine), ScoreBoard (forecasting and reporting dashboard), BlockBuster (group business optimization), Advance (AI-powered demand forecasting), HotStats (profitability benchmarking), and GameTime (select-service hotel revenue management). Duetto serves over 7,500 properties in more than 100 countries, with customers including Meliá, Sonesta, Virgin Hotels, and Sandman Hotel Group. Duetto integrates with major property management systems (PMS), central reservation systems (CRS), booking engines, and channel managers including Cloudbeds, Oracle OPERA / OHIP, Mews, Sabre, Amadeus, SiteMinder, and Infor. Duetto exposes an Open API for technical integration partners but does not publish a public, self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI specification — API access is partner-only and gated through a structured onboarding process with a self-testing toolkit. Revenue is generated through SaaS subscriptions to its revenue management products.

providers.name: Royal Caribbean Group
providers.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a global cruise vacation company operating Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. Royal Caribbean does not publish a public developer API. Travel partner and agent integration is operated through the CruisingPower B2B portal (cruisingpower.com), which requires authenticated agent access. The company also operates loyalty (Crown & Anchor Society) and consumer booking platforms with no public API surface.

providers.name: Swiss Education Group
providers.description: Swiss Education Group (SEG) is a Montreux-based alliance of internationally celebrated hospitality, business, and culinary arts schools in Switzerland, comprising Cesar Ritz Colleges, Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland, Swiss Hotel Management School, and HIM Business School. Across five campuses it educates more than 6,000 students from over 110 nationalities in hospitality management, culinary arts, and business. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass SEG publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Snackpass
providers.description: Snackpass is an all-in-one marketing, point-of-sale (POS), and payments platform built for quick-service and fast-casual restaurants. It unifies front-of-house and back-of-house operations in one system: cloud POS, integrated card and mobile payments, self-serve kiosks, online and QR/table ordering, a consumer mobile app, kitchen display systems, loyalty and rewards, SMS/marketing automation, and commission-free delivery. Snackpass serves thousands of restaurants from independent boba and coffee shops to national franchises and has facilitated tens of millions of guest transactions. The company is privately held and backed by a16z, Craft Ventures, and General Catalyst. Snackpass does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; third-party ordering and delivery integrations (Uber Eats, DoorDash, GrubHub) are brokered through partners such as Deliverect and GetOrder rather than a documented public API surface.

providers.name: Host Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: Host Hotels & Resorts is a leading lodging real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns luxury and upper-upscale hotels operating under premium brands in major U.S. and international markets. No public APIs are offered.

providers.name: Kitchensurfing
providers.description: Kitchensurfing was a New York City marketplace that booked professional chefs to shop for, cook, and serve meals in customers' own kitchens, founded in 2012 and backed by roughly $20M from Union Square Ventures, Spark Capital, and Tiger Global. It began as an advance-booking platform for private dinner parties and pivoted in 2015 to a flat-rate on-demand model in which a chef arrived and cooked dinner within a fixed window. Neither model produced sustainable demand against better-capitalized meal-kit and delivery competitors, and the company discontinued service and shut down on April 15, 2016. It never published a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Its GitHub organization survives with eleven public repositories - open-source Ruby/Rails forks and internal hackathon projects, last active in 2016 - but contains no client library or API definition. The kitchensurfing.com domain was subsequently re-registered by an unrelated cooking-products affiliate publisher and no longer represents this company.

providers.name: Service Properties Trust
providers.description: Service Properties Trust (NASDAQ: SVC) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) with approximately $9.9 billion invested across two asset categories: service-focused retail net lease properties and hotels. As of March 31, 2026 SVC owned 761 net lease properties (over 13.6 million sq ft) and 93 hotels (over 21,000 guest rooms) throughout the United States. The company is externally managed by The RMR Group (NASDAQ: RMR). SVC does not operate a public developer program and exposes no public APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or webhooks; investor-facing endpoints are limited to SEC filings, press releases, email alerts, and end-of-day stock quotes.

providers.name: Ellis Coffee Company
providers.description: Ellis Coffee Company is a Philadelphia-based wholesale coffee roaster founded in 1854 and now in its fourth generation of family ownership. Ellis supplies coffee, tea, hot chocolate, brewing equipment, and POS materials to restaurants, hotels, resorts, office coffee service (OCS) programs, convenience stores, universities, distributors, and vending operators. Customers place and manage orders through deliver.elliscoffee.com and request brewing equipment service through the OnUpkeep portal. Ellis Coffee Company does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, webhook program, SDK, or status page.

providers.name: HungryHub
providers.description: HungryHub is a restaurant reservation and dining-deals platform operating primarily in Bangkok, Thailand. It connects diners with fixed-price dining packages — all-you-can-eat buffets, omakase, fine dining, rooftop venues, hotel staycations and cruise dining — from luxury hotels and restaurants, often at significant savings. The consumer marketplace runs on the web and in mobile apps, while a separate business portal gives 2,000+ partner restaurants and hotel chains a booking and package-management dashboard. The company reports serving more than four million customers monthly and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. HungryHub publishes no public developer or partner API; this profile captures its public web, discovery and security surface.

providers.name: Related Companies
providers.description: Related Companies is a privately held, fully integrated real estate firm founded by Stephen Ross in 1972 as an affordable-housing developer and now active across luxury residential, affordable housing, retail, office, hospitality, data centers, and city-scale mixed-use development. Related is the developer of Hudson Yards in New York City, The Grand LA, Time Warner Center (now Deutsche Bank Center), The 78 in Chicago, and operates regional platforms including Related Beal, Related Midwest, Related California, Related Ross, and Related Argent in the UK. The firm owns and manages roughly 55,000 affordable and workforce housing units and has stated it has never converted a single affordable unit to market rate. Stephen Ross also owns a majority stake in Equinox Holdings (Equinox fitness clubs, Equinox Hotels, SoulCycle, Blink Fitness) and the Miami Dolphins / Hard Rock Stadium.

providers.name: HotelUrbano
providers.description: HotelUrbano (later rebranded Hurb) was a Brazilian online travel agency founded in January 2011 by Joao Ricardo Mendes and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, offering hotel bookings, flights, and flexible travel packages across domestic and international destinations. Once one of Brazil's largest OTAs and backed by investors including Insight Partners and Tiger Global, the company collapsed amid consumer-protection complaints: the Brazilian Ministry of Tourism revoked its Cadastur operating license on 14 April 2025 and the company ceased all operations on 25 October 2025. Its consumer domains (hotelurbano.com.br, hurb.com) no longer resolve and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI. The only surviving public technical surface is its GitHub organization (hurbcom), which hosts engineering coding challenges and open-source utility forks rather than product APIs. This profile is retained as a historical/defunct-company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hyatt Hotels
providers.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation is a global hospitality company managing a portfolio of hotel, resort, and residential brands. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and integration touchpoints associated with Hyatt Hotels.

providers.name: Kitchit
providers.description: Kitchit was a San Francisco on-demand private-chef marketplace founded in 2011 by Brendan Marshall and Ian Ferguson. The service matched consumers with vetted professional chefs who shopped, cooked, served, and cleaned up a multi-course meal in the customer's own home, booked through the kitchit.com web and mobile storefront. In 2015 the company pivoted from fully customized menus to a lower-priced standardized product marketed as "Kitchit Tonight," priced around $39 per person with a two-person minimum. Kitchit served more than 100,000 meals across roughly five years of operation and reported a net promoter score of 87. It raised approximately $8.1M, with investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Crosslink Capital, Javelin Venture Partners, and Otter Rock Capital. The company announced its shutdown in April 2016, with the founders citing a finite investment runway that ended amid broad upheaval in food-tech, alongside contemporaneous failures at SpoonRocket, Dinner Lab, and Kitchensurfing. Kitchit is defunct: it operates no website, developer portal, or public API today, and no public API surface was ever published. This profile is retained as a historical/defunct provider record for network completeness.

providers.name: MGM Resorts International
providers.description: MGM Resorts International is a global entertainment company with national and international locations featuring best-in-class hotels and casinos, state-of-the-art meetings and conference spaces, and dining and entertainment venues. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for MGM Resorts International.

providers.name: MisterBnB
providers.description: misterb&b (operated by SFO84 inc.) is the world's largest LGBTQ-focused travel and accommodation booking platform, connecting gay and queer travelers with LGBTQ-friendly rentable lodging including private rooms, apartments, hotels, and homestays across more than 200,000 cities worldwide. Founded in Paris in 2014 by Matthieu Jost, François de Landes, Marc Dedonder, and Julien Delon and now headquartered in San Francisco, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Enrichment found no public developer/API surface: the consumer site is Cloudflare-protected (403 to non-browser clients), the github.com/misterbnb organization holds only open-source Ruby/JS forks, and no well-known, OpenAPI, SDK, or MCP artifacts are published. Host-partner connectivity is offered indirectly via channel managers such as Guesty rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings
providers.description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a global cruise company operating three premium brands: Norwegian Cruise Line (pioneer of Freestyle Cruising), Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. The company operates a combined fleet of more than 30 ships sailing to over 700 destinations worldwide. No public developer portal or external API offering has been identified for Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings; travel agent and global distribution system (GDS) integrations are handled through contracted partner programs rather than a self-serve developer API.

providers.name: RoomRaccoon
providers.description: RoomRaccoon is an all-in-one hotel management software platform for independent hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, hostels, and small chains, founded in 2017 by Tymen van Dyl and Nadja Buckenberger and headquartered in Breda, Netherlands with major operations in Cape Town, South Africa, plus offices in Valencia, Spain and Lisbon, Portugal. The platform bundles a cloud Property Management System (PMS), a Channel Manager that synchronises rates, availability, and restrictions across 200+ OTAs, metasearch engines, GDSs, and bedbanks, a commission-free Booking Engine for direct website bookings with bookable add-ons, RaccoonPay for integrated, multi-currency guest payments, and RaccoonRev for competitor insights and revenue management. RoomRaccoon advertises 400+ integrations with partners such as Booking.com, Expedia, Lightspeed, and Sage, and was named World's Best Hotel Channel Manager at the 2023 World Travel Tech Awards. A connectivity / partner API exists at api.roomraccoon.com (e.g. POS endpoint at /api/?type=POS&version=2) but is access-controlled: prospective integrators must request an API key and Hotel ID by emailing connectivity@roomraccoon.com, and no public OpenAPI specification, public SDKs, or public GitHub organisation are published.

providers.name: Axelrod
providers.description: Axelrod is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an autonomous operating layer for boutique, independent, and luxury hotels and resorts. Its software runs daily front-of-house and back-of-house operations, coordinating arrivals, rooms, rates, access, maintenance, supplies, and owner reporting inside the systems and teams a property already has in place, integrating with existing PMS, channel, pricing, and accounting platforms rather than requiring net-new tooling. Founded by Adrian Stoica and Saman Sayahpour, the company markets itself as "boutique hotels that run themselves" and reports being live across four continents with Michelin Key awarded and Marriott Luxury Collection properties. Axelrod does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Blink Booking
providers.description: Blink Booking was a Madrid, Spain based mobile application for last-minute hotel booking, founded in 2011 by Rebeca Minguela and Miguel Ortega Rodriguez. The app presented travellers with a curated daily selection of four discounted hotels for same-day stays, working with more than 2,000 hotel partners across eight European countries, and competed directly with HotelTonight. The company raised approximately $2.5M in a Series A round in May 2012 from Ventech, Uncork Capital (then SoftTech VC), 500 Global (then 500 Startups) and Kibo Ventures. Groupon acquired Blink Booking in September 2013 to strengthen its Groupon Getaways travel division; the app was rebranded "Blink by Groupon" and was wound down over the following months. The company is defunct and publishes no developer surface, no API, and no documentation. Its former blinkbooking.com domain lapsed and was re-registered in August 2020 by an unrelated party; it now redirects to a third-party gambling site and must not be treated as a company property.

providers.name: Bloomin' Brands
providers.description: Bloomin' Brands, Inc. (NASDAQ: BLMN) is one of the largest casual dining restaurant companies in the world, headquartered in Tampa, Florida and founded in 1988. It owns and operates four restaurant concepts — Outback Steakhouse, Carrabba's Italian Grill, Bonefish Grill, and Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar — across the United States and internationally (Brazil, South Korea, Hong Kong, and China). The company's consumer technology centers on the Web-based Dine Rewards loyalty program, per-brand mobile apps (iOS/Android) for online ordering, curbside takeaway, delivery, table payment, reservations, and waitlist, and corporate supplier portals (BBI Connect). Bloomin' Brands does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; the apis collection below is intentionally empty.

providers.name: Boyd Gaming
providers.description: Boyd Gaming is a multi-jurisdictional casino entertainment company that owns and operates 28+ gaming properties across 10 U.S. states. The company offers casino gaming, hotel accommodations, dining, entertainment, and sports betting through its Boyd Sports platform. Boyd Rewards is the company's loyalty program spanning all properties, accessible via web portal and mobile app.

providers.name: Casai
providers.description: Casai was a technology-enabled short-term and furnished-apartment rental company operating across Latin America (notably Mexico and Brazil), surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The enrichment pass found no active developer surface for this entity. The casai.com domain now hosts an unrelated luxury villa rental business (Premium Holiday Rentals and Villas, curated by TravelAI), and no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or public API is published under the original company. With no spec-bearing surface, no downstream enrichment artifacts (packages, well-known, MCP, scopes, errors, conformance, etc.) could be produced without fabrication, so this profile remains an identity-only lead.

providers.name: DCS-Touristik (DCS Travel)
providers.description: DCS-Touristik GmbH, trading as DCS Travel (dcs.travel), is a German river- and sea-cruise operator based in Nagel, Germany. The company organizes river cruises on major European waterways — primarily the Danube and the Rhine — as well as sea cruises along the Croatian coast, operating its own vessels including the DCS Amethyst 1 and DCS Amethyst 2. Its business is direct consumer travel booking: multi-day cruise packages (roughly 3 to 12 days), organized transfers and shore excursions, themed sailings, travel-insurance partnerships, and early-booking discounts. This is a consumer-facing tourism brand with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation. It was originally added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio stub; that classification appears to be a false match (the "early-bird" cruise discount wording rather than the Earlybird venture firm), and no API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Effa
providers.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: FabHotels
providers.description: FabHotels is an Indian branded-budget hotel chain and online booking platform, founded in 2014 by Vaibhav Aggarwal and Adarsh Manpuria and headquartered in Gurugram. It operates a network of 1500+ standardized economy hotels across 80+ cities under the FabHotel, FabHotel Prime, and Via brands, with quality-controlled amenities such as free WiFi, air conditioning, and 24/7 security. Consumers book stays through the FabHotels website and its iOS and Android apps; the company also runs a franchise program for property owners and corporate-stay offerings, and is backed by Accel and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface is advertised — this remains a business-to-consumer travel brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: FavStay
providers.description: FavStay is a hotel and accommodation booking company in the travel and hospitality sector, surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the public site at favstay.com is offline (the host returns a Microsoft Azure Web App 404 error and its TLS certificate does not match the domain), indicating the product is defunct or the web presence has been retired. The domain still resolves with Google Workspace email and an SPF record delegating to the Juniper (ejuniper.com) hospitality booking engine, but no public developer surface, API documentation, or machine-readable specification could be found.

providers.name: Getaway
providers.description: Getaway was a consumer hospitality startup that operated a network of minimalist tiny cabins ("Outposts") in nature within a couple hours' drive of major US cities, letting people book short, disconnected nature escapes. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of cowboy-ventures (sector: consumer). The company was acquired by Marriott International and rebranded as "Postcard Cabins" under Marriott's Outdoor Collection; the getaway.house domain now 301-redirects entirely to the Marriott Postcard Cabins brand page. Getaway operates a consumer booking website only and publishes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface, so this profile carries identity metadata rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: H World Group
providers.description: H World Group Limited (formerly Huazhu Group / China Lodging Group) is one of the world's largest multi-brand hotel operators, headquartered in Shanghai, China and founded in 2005 by Ji Qi. It franchises, manages, and leases-and-operates thousands of hotels across economy-to-luxury tiers under brands including HanTing, Ji Hotel, Orange, Hi Inn, Elan, Starway, Crystal Orange, Manxin, Madison, Blossom House, CitiGO and Ni Hao, plus the upscale European Deutsche Hospitality portfolio (Steigenberger, IntercityHotel, MAXX, Jaz in the City, Zleep) and the H Rewards loyalty program. The company is dual-listed on NASDAQ (HTHT) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (1179). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; H World is a consumer hospitality operator and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: HouseTrip
providers.description: HouseTrip was a London-based online vacation-rental marketplace founded in 2009 by Arnaud Bertrand and Junjun Chen, backed by Accel and Balderton Capital, that grew to roughly 300,000 European holiday properties before being acquired by TripAdvisor in April 2016. The standalone HouseTrip brand and its developer surface (formerly dev.housetrip.com) have since been retired; the housetrip.com domain now serves TripAdvisor's HolidayLettings marketplace. This profile is retained as a historical consumer-sector company record in the API Evangelist network; no live first-party API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published under the HouseTrip brand.

providers.name: Huixiaoer
providers.description: Huixiaoer (会小二) is a Chinese online platform for booking meeting venues, hotel conference rooms, and event spaces, operated by Beijing Yundong Digital Media Technology (北京云动数字媒体技术有限公司). It connects companies with a network of conference hotels and specialty venues across China and 20+ overseas cities, offering venue matching, price negotiation, and one-on-one meeting-planning advisors, plus bundled catering, accommodation, transportation, staging, team-building, incentive travel, and exhibition booth services on a free-to-client, commission-based model. Backed by DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Jiumaojiu
providers.description: Jiumaojiu (Jiu Mao Jiu International Holdings, HKEX: 09922) is a Chinese casual-dining restaurant group headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since January 2020. Founded roughly three decades ago, it operates 600+ restaurants across mainland China, Southeast Asia and North America under five brands: Jiumaojiu (Shanxi handmade-noodle cuisine), Tai Er (sour cabbage fish, 400+ locations), Song Hot Pot (Chongqing hot pot), Shan Wai Mian (Guizhou sour-soup hot pot) and Chao Na Bian (Chaoshan grilled beef). Backed by IDG Capital. As a consumer food-and-beverage operator it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity lead.

providers.name: JustBook
providers.description: JustBook was a Berlin, Germany based mobile hotel booking startup that offered same-day and last-minute hotel deals at discounted rates, in a model similar to HotelTonight. Founded in 2012, it grew to cover last-minute inventory across more than 120 cities in Europe and the United States through its iOS, Android, and web apps. The company was backed by Creandum, DN Capital, and Earlybird Venture Capital (among roughly 21 investors, raising about $3.74M) and was acquired by UK luxury-travel company Secret Escapes in January 2014 to strengthen its German-market and mobile presence. JustBook no longer operates as an independent brand and publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation; this profile is retained as a network record of a defunct, acquired Creandum portfolio company. Note: the justbook.de domain is now an unrelated book price-comparison site (BookFinder) and is not connected to this company.

providers.name: Life House
providers.description: Life House was a vertically integrated hotel software, brand and management company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Miami Beach, Florida. It built its own back-of-house operating system — property management, revenue management, digital marketing and financial operations — for independent hotels, ran more than 50 properties across the United States, Mexico and Canada, and from 2021 sold the platform to third-party hoteliers. It raised over $100M from Inovia Capital, KAYAK, Tiger Global, Trinity Ventures, Sound Ventures and JLL. In December 2024 Life House combined its management portfolio with Lark Hotels to form Lark Hospitality — in which Lark holds the controlling interest — and spun its AI revenue-management platform out as Diamo. Life House never operated a public developer program: it was a consumer of hotel APIs (notably the Mews Open API) rather than a publisher of one, lifehousehotels.com now 301-redirects to larkhotels.com, no api/developer/docs subdomain resolves in DNS, and its GitHub organization holds a single fork of a third-party JavaScript library.

providers.name: Local Kitchens
providers.description: Local Kitchens is a restaurant company that operates multi-brand "food hall" locations where a single kitchen prepares menu items from a curated set of local and national restaurant brands for on-demand pickup and delivery, ordered through its consumer website and mobile app. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, it is a consumer-facing hospitality and food-ordering business. As of this pass it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation — its web presence is a Cloudflare-fronted marketing and ordering site (Google Workspace email, Klaviyo, Twilio, Zoom in its DNS records).

providers.name: Luxe Nomad
providers.description: The Luxe Nomad is a luxury travel booking company offering curated villas, private residences, and boutique hotels across Asia-Pacific and beyond. It operates as a consumer-facing booking platform rather than a developer-first API provider. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, this profile was probed for a public API surface, developer portal, and discovery documents; none were found (the site is bot-protected and returns no developer, API, or /.well-known resources). It remains catalogued as a company lead with a probed domain-security profile.

providers.name: OYO
providers.description: OYO (Oravel Stays Limited) is an India-headquartered hospitality company that operates a franchise and aggregator platform for budget and mid-market hotels, homes, and vacation rentals across India, Southeast Asia, Europe, and other markets. Founded in 2013 by Ritesh Agarwal and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, OYO standardizes independent properties under its brands and distributes them through its consumer apps and website. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company; as of this enrichment pass OYO publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: Oyster.com (TripAdvisor)
providers.description: Oyster.com is a hotel review and travel-photography website owned by TripAdvisor, known for its in-person "Photo Fakeout" investigations and professionally shot, unedited hotel photos across destinations worldwide. It operates as a consumer-facing WordPress-based review and booking-referral site rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or well-known discovery documents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Pace Revenue
providers.description: Pace Revenue was a London-based revenue management and dynamic pricing platform for hotels and hospitality operators that used machine learning to recommend optimal room rates from real-time demand, market, and booking-pace signals. Founded in 2016 and backed by Speedinvest, Pace was acquired by FLYR in 2023, and its revenue-optimization technology has since been folded into FLYR's hospitality commercial platform. Pace Revenue does not currently publish a public developer portal or an openly documented API specification; developer resources for the combined offering now live behind FLYR's gated developer knowledge base. This profile was surfaced as a Speedinvest portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public machine-readable API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Rebookify
providers.description: Rebookify is a travel-technology company that helps travel agencies and travel management companies save money on hotel bookings by continuously monitoring the price of existing hotel reservations and automatically rebooking them at lower rates whenever prices drop, capturing the savings without changing the guest's stay. Backed by 500 Global, Rebookify operates a business-facing web product at rebookify.com. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface has been identified.

providers.name: RedDoorz
providers.description: RedDoorz is a Southeast Asian budget-hospitality technology company that operates a franchise and management network of economy hotels and rooms across Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand. Through its consumer website and mobile apps travelers can search, book, and pay for value-priced stays, while its "List your property" program onboards independent hotel owners onto the RedDoorz brand, distribution, loyalty, and property-management platform. Backed by 500 Global and Qiming Venture Partners, the company operates a consumer booking product rather than a public developer platform; as of this pass it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile tracks the company's digital and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Savioke
providers.description: Savioke is a robotics company, backed by GV, that built the Relay autonomous delivery robot used by hotels and hospitals to move items such as amenities, medications, lab samples, and supplies through facilities without human assistance. The company now operates as Relay Robotics (savioke.com redirects to relayrobotics.com). It publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface; enrichment found only a marketing/contact site.

providers.name: SeeMexico
providers.description: SeeMexico is a B2B corporate travel management platform and business travel agency in Mexico that lets companies book flights, hotels, and car rentals from a single platform. It offers corporate rates, business credit, cashback, direct invoicing (facturacion), and a dedicated account executive to streamline managed business travel. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site is a Duda-built marketing site and no public developer portal, API documentation, or programmatic surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: SnapShyft
providers.description: SnapShyft is an on-demand staffing marketplace that connects hospitality, food-and-beverage, and events venues with vetted gig workers for short-notice shifts. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass its primary domain (snapshyft.com) serves a coming-soon placeholder page and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, changelog, or /.well-known discovery surface. The only machine-verifiable signal harvested was domain/transport security (TLS 1.3, HSTS, DMARC quarantine); the profile remains a lead awaiting a live developer surface.

providers.name: Syft
providers.description: Syft (originally Syft Online Ltd, later branded "Syft by Indeed") is a UK-founded flexible-staffing marketplace launched in London in 2015 by Jack Beaman and Novo Abakare.
